name: NY-20
label: Safe D

key_factors: Tonko is a well-established incumbent in a D+8 district
No polling or expert ratings, but fundamentals align
model.rationale: Tonko combines incumbency, a large money advantage, and a district leaning Democratic by eight points, while challenger Ambrosio has raised almost nothing. Markets and fundamentals both point to a comfortable Tonko win.
model.watch: A late surge in Republican outside spending or an unexpectedly strong national GOP environment could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Paul Tonko seeks another term in a Capital Region district that leans Democratic by about eight points and has favored him repeatedly. He enters with roughly $958,000 raised and $404,000 on hand, while Republican Ralph Ambrosio has raised under $30,000 with no outside spending on either side. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Tonko about a 94% chance of winning.

The fundamentals point the same direction: incumbency, a clear financial edge, and a favorable partisan lean all favor Tonko. The forecast expects a Democratic win by roughly twenty points, with modest uncertainty given the absence of polling.
